old: The fiftieth-year release in Leviticus, when debts were forgiven and land returned to its original families.
new: The fiftieth-year release in Leviticus 25, when land returned to its original families and bonded servants went free. The release of debts every seventh year comes from Deuteronomy 15.
why: Precision. Leviticus 25 ties the Jubilee to the return of land and the freeing of bonded servants. The cancellation of debts is the seventh-year release in Deuteronomy 15:1 to 2.
